concerns.text: Confirmed from the data-resources lens: the plan's core data resource is unobtainable as specified. FR-001 mandates Battery Archive with 'No other dataset source may be substituted', yet no verified programmatic endpoint exists, and none of the verified URLs (crop/sea-ice/audio/3D-model) contain voltage/current/temperature cycling traces or capacity-fade targets — they are wrong-domain datasets and cannot serve even as partial substitutes. The plan correctly refuses synthetic stand-ins (FR-012), so no result-producing task (SC-001/004/005/006/007/009/010) can run. The scope-revision request (verified mirror/endpoint, e.g. a Zenodo/HF snapshot of Battery Archive or Severson et al. 2019 data, OR relaxing FR-001) must be resolved at the spec level before this plan can be approved as executable; the plan should not advance to tasks with all result paths blocked.
